clips.title: The story
paras: Makaba Flathoof is a tauren survivor hailing from Camp Aparaje in the Stonetalon Mountains. Having witnessed the devastation of his home and people at the hands of the Grimtotem clan, he seeks brave champions of the Horde to bring vengeance upon the attackers and ensure his family's safety.

Makaba Flathoof represents the tragic toll of internal strife among the tauren. His home, Camp Aparaje in the Stonetalon Mountains, fell victim to a ruthless surprise attack by the Grimtotem clan. While many tauren strive for peace and unity under the leadership of Cairne Bloodhoof, the treacherous Grimtotem continually sow discord and violence, leaving survivors like Makaba displaced and grieving.
